definitions.ask: Should the implementing agent unblock apollo's parked waiters through a /sase_gate after the fix is verified?
definitions.why: the fix can't reach runners that already imported the broken module; the marker must be cleared

choices.label: Propose the apollo marker scrub (plus any kill) as a gate you confirm; 9m--1 resumes on approval
Leave apollo alone; you run the unblock steps listed in this plan yourself

definitions.ask: Should bob-cli-a0.13--1 be stopped before apollo is unblocked?
definitions.why: 9m's own next-action prompt treats bob-cli-a0.13--1 as stranded and finishes its work itself

choices.label: Stop it first; 9m--1 already owns bob-cli-a0.13's reader sweep and closeout
Let it resume alongside 9m--1; its 16:04Z reader-launch follow-up will likely duplicate 9m's work
